limitations_and_boundaries: The cellular context embedding strategy is only applicable to cell-line-derived contexts, not patient-derived contexts.
The cellular context embedding strategy showed only limited improvements, mainly in PCC-delta and Common-DEGs, and did not consistently surpass baseline methods across all metrics and datasets.
Datasets in certain test scenarios were insufficient, which may lead to bias in conclusions.
The study does not address the challenge of poor performance on population-distribution metrics.
Robustness evaluation focuses on technical artifacts (noise, sparsity) but does not capture biological variability in perturbation responses across different cellular contexts or genetic backgrounds.

research_questions.statement: How do current computational methods perform in predicting single-cell perturbation responses across different generalization scenarios?
